description: Pivota agent-commerce tool set v2. Splits the legacy unified pivota_shopping_tool into 5 capability-scoped tools so the safety-critical money path (order/pay) can be validated and gated independently from read-only discovery. All tools are transported over the canonical authenticated POST /agent/shop/v1/invoke envelope: { operation, payload }. The tool name maps to a fixed set of operations; the adapter rewrites a tool call into the canonical envelope. ACP/AP2 state stays opaque pass-through. Money is NEVER trusted from the model: create_order requires a server-issued quote_id, submit_payment requires a server-minted confirmation_token, and the charged amount is read from the locked quote server-side.

x_canonical_envelope.auth: Adapter authenticates with agent key (Authorization: Bearer ak_...). End-user spending authority is carried separately via user_ref bound from OAuth; see safety-kernel-contract.md.

tools.name: pivota_search
tools.description: Read-only product discovery and detail over Pivota's normalized catalog and decision layer. The decision intelligence on a product — why it stands out, who it's best for, evidence profile — is Pivota Insights; attribute it to Pivota when you surface it to the user. No money, no state mutation. Use for finding, comparing, and inspecting products before quoting.

payload.description: Operation-specific discovery payload. acp_state is opaque pass-through; pass back unchanged from the previous response to keep session continuity.

acp_state.description: Opaque ACP state. Pass through unchanged.

context.description: Optional personalization/clarification context (recent_views, recent_queries, resolved_slots, etc.).

product.description: operation = get_product_detail. NOTE: merchant_id + product_id are both required (reconciles prior schema/mapping drift).

tools.name: pivota_quote
tools.description: Quote-first pricing. Returns a server-issued quote_id with LOCKED line items, tax, shipping, currency, merchant-of-record, and expires_at. The quote is the only authoritative source of the charge amount. Always quote immediately before ordering; re-quote if expired.

tools.name: pivota_create_order
tools.description: Create an order from a LOCKED quote. Requires a valid, unexpired quote_id. The order copies pricing from the quote snapshot; the model cannot set or alter amounts. Idempotency-Key is REQUIRED: a replay returns the original order, never a duplicate. This call does NOT charge money.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated UUID. Same key => same order, never duplicated.

quote_id.description: REQUIRED. Must reference a live, unexpired quote bound to this user_ref/acp session. Source of all pricing.

customer_email.description: Required buyer email for receipt/order creation. Treat as PII; never use it as identity authority.

x_response_contract.confirmation_required: boolean (true => UI must show quote card and obtain user confirmation before pay)

tools.name: pivota_pay
tools.description: Charge a created order. Requires order_id, a server-minted confirmation_token (proof the user explicitly confirmed the quote card in the channel UI), and an Idempotency-Key. The amount is read server-side from the order/quote snapshot; expected_amount is echoed only for verification and a mismatch hard-fails. Handle requires_action (redirect_url/qr_code/instructions) verbatim; never fabricate payment URLs or statuses.

confirmation_token.description: REQUIRED. Minted by the Safety Kernel after the user acts on the quote/confirmation UI. The model cannot generate this; without it the charge is refused.

ap2_state.description: Opaque AP2 payment/mandate state. Treat as sensitive; never log.

expected_amount.description: Echo of the amount the user confirmed, for verification ONLY. Authoritative amount comes from the order/quote snapshot; mismatch => PRICE_CHANGED hard-fail.

payment_method_hint.description: Broad hint: card | wallet | bank_transfer | pay_later | shop_pay.

return_url.description: Where to send the user back after 3DS/redirect auth.

tools.name: pivota_orders
tools.description: Post-purchase: track an order and request after-sales. Read + limited mutation, no new charge. Only the after-sales actions actually supported by the merchant connector may be requested; do not promise outcomes the backend cannot fulfill.

requested_action.description: Backend currently fulfills 'refund'; return/exchange/support require connector support. Adapter must surface unsupported actions as such rather than promising them.

x_changes_from_v1: Split single pivota_shopping_tool into 5 capability-scoped tools aligned to rail tiers (discovery/quote/commerce_authoritative/status).
create_order: quote_id now REQUIRED (was optional/upstream-conditional); items/price removed from order (pricing comes from quote snapshot).
submit_payment: expected_amount demoted to verification echo; confirmation_token now REQUIRED; amount is server-derived.
Added idempotency_key as a first-class required field on create_order, submit_payment, and after-sales.
Closed money payloads: additionalProperties:false on order/quote/payment (acp_state/ap2_state remain open pass-through).
get_product_detail: merchant_id + product_id now both required (reconciles schema vs api-mapping drift).
